jobs.description: Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients in the NHS For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be. Gamechanging, right? jobs.title: Rust Software Engineer - Rust / C++ (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Quantum Systems develops autonomous, multi-domain systems that operate in the air, on the ground and on the water. Behind every platform is software that has to work reliably in the real world, with limited resources, unreliable connectivity and no second chances. We are looking for software engineers who like to build exactly that kind of software in Rust and C++. You will join our engineering organization and work on production code that runs on real vehicles and sensors, across a broad range of challenges from low-level systems to scalable services. We are looking for engineers who quickly understand a complex system and its domain, and who use that understanding to get leverage: designing the architecture, setting the guardrails and guiding several AI agents at once to build, test and iterate faster, while taking full responsibility for the result. What is your Day to Day Mission: Build and maintain production-grade software in Rust and C++ for autonomous platforms and the systems around them. Design performant, fault-tolerant components that run on embedded Linux, edge hardware and in the cloud. Develop communication layers, data pipelines and real-time processing for sensor-driven, distributed systems. Work with hardware and robotics engineers to get software from simulation and test benches onto real vehicles. Use AI agents as part of your daily engineering workflow: break down problems, run several agents in parallel, review their output critically and make sure it meets our quality and safety standards. Own your code end to end: design, review, testing, deployment and troubleshooting of systems in the field. Shape architecture decisions and help raise engineering standards in a growing team. What you bring to the team: Several years of professional experience (ideally 4+) building software in Rust and/or C++, including production code. A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.

Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team! We are looking for a Structural Analysis Engineer in Toulouse. jobs.title: Junior Product Manager:in
jobs.description: Über Valova Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann. Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben, während die meisten deutschen Kliniken bereits rote Zahlen schreiben. Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden. Erst Deutschland, dann Europa. Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up-Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf dich! Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist Mit Valova kodieren Kliniken ihre Fälle schon heute deutlich schneller. Und das ist erst der Anfang: Wir bauen Valova Schritt für Schritt über die Kodierung hinaus aus, und jede Erweiterung muss im Klinikalltag funktionieren, nicht nur in der Demo. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Du findest heraus, wo Kodierteams Zeit und Erlöse verlieren, entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes bauen, und bringst es mit unserem Engineeringteam live. Du bist die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Code und zwischen unserem Team und den Menschen, die täglich mit Valova arbeiten. Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in weniger Minuten pro Fall und in mehr Fällen, die Valova ohne Korrektur abrechnet. Deine Rolle im Team Du berichtest direkt an Malte, unseren Produkt Lead, und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Engineers zusammen. Fachlich arbeitest Du eng mit unseren Kodier- und Abrechnungsexpert:innen: Sie kennen die Regeln, Du machst daraus Produkt. In Klinikprojekten arbeitest Du Hand in Hand mit unserem Vertrieb und Customer Success und auf Klinikseite mit Medizincontrol

jobs.title: Service Network Manager (m/w/d) – Partnernetz & HEERO Cloud
jobs.description: Du baust den Service, der die neue Generation auf der Straße hält. Hohe Reisebereitschaft (DACH) ist für diese Rolle zentral. Für unsere Kunden zählt am Ende eines: dass das Fahrzeug morgens fährt. Bei HEERO Motors ist Zuverlässigkeit deshalb kein Versprechen im Prospekt, sondern ein System – und dieses System baust du. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. Threat Operations is part of 1Password’s Security organization, bringing together Cyber Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, and Security Incident Response. Together we study how threat actors operate, turn that into high-quality detections, and respond quickly when something goes wrong. Interns work across all three teams, with time and focus shaped by your interests and our needs, so you see how intelligence becomes real defense. We care about turning intelligence into action, and we value blameless learning and psychological safety. This is a remote opportunity within Canada/US. This position will be for 4 months - January to April 2027. What You Can Expect:

AXS verantwortet u.a. das Ticketing für AEG Presents, dem führenden Veranstalter von Tourneen, Festivals und Konzerte weltweit. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung sowie den europäischen und globalen Marketingteams entwickelst und steuerst du wirkungsvolle Marketingstrategien, die den Ticketverkauf steigern, die Markenbekanntheit stärken und das Wachstum von AXS in Deutschland vorantreiben. jobs.title: (Senior) B2G Manager: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
jobs.description: “This is not your typical B2G role.” B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you own it. You'll be responsible for a big share of RIZM's funding sources, with real influence on RIZM's cash flow and on how fast we grow. You'll be tapping into new sources that most companies never even look at. Why this role exists RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're looking for someone to own B2G as a business line at RIZM, from public funding all the way to municipalities as paying customers. What you'll own Public funding as a growth channel. Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: build the pipeline, actively own and track our running programmes, forge consortia and get applications approved. Connect research. Coordinate our research collaboration with Stanford and translate it into funded projects. Build the machine, AI-first. Set up your own systems, tracking and automation, so one person can run a funding pipeline that usually takes a whole team. You decide how the role works behind the scenes. Take over and scale ReNET-EV. Own our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region) and roll the model out to more municipalities. Turn municipalities into customers. Win cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies that use RIZM for heat planning, climate strategy and business park development. Set up offers and procurement routes for the public sector. Orchestrate the ecosystem. Bring chambers of commerce (IHKs), economic development agencies, utilities and industry partners together in joint projects. Build the data foundation. Tap into public and municipal data that makes our models more precise

jobs.description: Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose! Fastned owns and operates a network of 400+ fast charging stations across 10 European countries, allowing electric vehicle drivers to charge their car with 100% green energy in just 15 minutes. Your role Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve. We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. Traditional cybersecurity analysis techniques often focus on identifying vulnerabilities and possible attack paths, with limited support for reasoning about the strategic interactions between attackers and defenders. The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges through formal verification. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for modelling and verifying cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. Tu es passionné par la finance et la comptabilité, mais tu souhaites aller au-delà des chiffres et contribuer activement à la digitalisation des entreprises ? Chez Fidigit, nos clients sont au centre de nos préoccupations, car nous offrons un service exceptionnel grâce à l'installation d'ERP Abacus et à nos collaborateurs dévoués. En tant que membre du groupe Fidinam, une société de conseil leader dans les domaines de la fiscalité, des entreprises, de l'immobilier et du conseil numérique en Suisse, nous sommes très bien positionnés avec plus de 15 bureaux dans le monde et plus de 300 consultants. Avec des sites à Berne, Genève, Lugano, Lucerne et Zurich, nous sommes le seul distributeur Abacus présent dans les trois régions linguistiques de Suisse. Nous nous concentrons sur le conseil à nos clients dans les domaines de la numérisation et de l'optimisation des processus. Ce que tu feras chez nous : Tu accompagnes nos clients dans leurs projets Abacus Finance, de la conception au déploiement et à la formation. Tu interviens comme consultant et chef de projet partiel et prends la responsabilité de ton domaine. Tu analyses les processus financiers et développes des solutions adaptées dans Abacus. Tu travailles sur des thèmes tels que les flux financiers, la comptabilité analytique, les immobilisations, la budgétisation, les indicateurs et le reporting. Tu assures le paramétrage des applications Abacus dans ton domaine d’expertise. Tu conseilles et accompagnes nos clients, sur site ou à distance. Tu développes des relations durables avec nos clients et contribues à l’évolution continue de leurs solutions. Ton profil : Tu disposes d’une formation en finance et comptabilité et tu as une forte affinité pour l’IT et la digitalisation. Tu maîtrises les principes comptables et souhaites les combiner avec les ERP et les processus digitaux. Tu as de bonnes capacités analytiques et travailles de manière structuré

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (H/F)
jobs.description: Chez Kanal, nous avons une mission : révolutionner l'expérience client pour les marques e-commerce. Nous croyons que chaque interaction doit être aussi simple, personnelle et efficace qu'une conversation avec un ami. Notre plateforme permet aux entreprises d'exploiter la puissance de WhatsApp pour créer des stratégies conversationnelles exceptionnelles, fidéliser leur audience et booster leurs ventes. En rejoignant Kanal aujourd'hui, vous intégrez l'équipe fondatrice passionnée et ambitieuse au tout début d'une aventure excitante. C'est une occasion unique de laisser votre empreinte, de grandir avec nous et de participer activement à la construction d'un futur leader du marketing conversationnel en France et dans le Monde. Kanal accompagne déjà + de 500 clients activement en Europe et dans le monde et recherche à s'étendre de plus en plus !!! Vos missions En tant que Customer Success Manager (H, tu seras le partenaire stratégique de nos clients et le garant de leur succès sur notre plateforme. Ton rôle sera central pour faire de Kanal un outil indispensable à leur croissance. Support client : Traiter l'ensemble des tickets entrants (chat, formulaires, signalements de bugs) via notre outil Gleap. Diagnostiquer les problèmes rencontrés par les utilisateurs, proposer des solutions immédiates ou des contournements viables (visio / chat) Suivre les indicateurs clés de réactivité et de satisfaction (CSAT, temps de première réponse, temps de résolution, NPS). Rédiger et mettre à jour la base de connaissances (centre d'aide, FAQs,macros de réponse). Vos compétences Passionné(e) par le client (Client-Centric) : Ta priorité absolue est la satisfaction de tes clients. Tu as une empathie naturelle qui te pousse à comprendre leurs défis et à tout faire pour les aider à réussir. Excellent(e) Communicant(e) : Tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques, présenter des résultats de manière claire et adapter ton discours à différents interlocuteurs (marketing, e-commerce, IT...). Esprit

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – AI Agents & Enterprise Software
jobs.description: You love building something people can actually use: the moment an integration works, an agent takes a tedious task off someone’s hands, or an idea becomes a useful tool. At XALT, you work closely with the people you build for, taking their solution from the first conversation into production. Your customers will be enterprises and public-sector organisations. Your focus will be AI agents with XALT Northstar or development platforms in the Atlassian ecosystem. We will work out together which area fits your experience and interests; working across both is possible. What you learn in customer projects will feed back into our own products. What we are working towards We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on. What you will do Turn business problems into practical technical solutions together with the customer. Write production code and integrate agents into existing systems and workflows. With a Northstar focus, build and operate personal and operational agents using MCP servers, Agent Skills, evals, guardrails and observability. With an Atlassian focus, develop platforms and workflows using Forge, Rovo and CI/CD so development teams can use agents reliably. Take solutions into production, evaluate their quality and improve them based on actual use. Bring insights from customer projects into our products. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About Valova We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss . We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us! Why this role matters Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital. Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand. That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer, you own technical go-lives from start to finish : from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team . Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn. This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management where others do the building. And it’s not a desk job: you’ll regularly be on site in hospitals How the role sits in the team You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on connectors, deployment

jobs.description: Brief info about Vinted  Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we re looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania s first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we ve grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.  Information about the position  At Vinted we are devoted to making second-hand the first choice worldwide. Vinted Pay is the regulated payments entity that makes it possible through enabling Vinted users to spend money, receive money, keep money and payout, while keeping them safe from financial crime. We are establishing a new AML & Fraud Prevention product domain within Vinted Pay. jobs.title: Ehrenamt · remote · 4–6 Std./Woche: Projektleiter / Projektmanager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du hast Freude daran, Ideen in konkrete Projekte zu verwandeln, Menschen zusammenzubringen und Vorhaben von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung zu begleiten? Vielleicht bringst du bereits Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, in der Organisationsentwicklung oder in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Teams mit. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für spannende Projekte mit gesellschaftlicher Wirkung. Eines davon ist DEHIB Masterminds, unser Qualifizierungs- und Leadership-Programm, das ehrenamtliches Engagement mit fachlicher Weiterbildung, Persönlichkeitsentwicklung und praktischer Führungserfahrung verbindet. Du musst nicht jede Projektmanagementmethode beherrschen. Viel wichtiger sind uns Eigeninitiative, Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele zu begeistern Gleich vorweg: Das ist ein Ehrenamt Die Aufgabe ist unbezahlt und begründet kein Arbeitsverhältnis. Wir suchen Menschen, die ihre Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Ideen einbringen möchten, weil sie gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen und gleichzeitig selbst Verantwortung übernehmen wollen. Wer wir sind Der Deutsche Hilfsbund e.V. (DEHIB) bündelt Hilfsorganisationen und bringt sie mit Menschen aus Wirtschaft, Politik und Wissenschaft zusammen, damit soziales Engagement mehr bewirkt. Wir verbinden Verbände, schaffen professionelle Strukturen und bauen bundesweit eine Plattform für gesellschaftliche Wirkung auf. Mit Projekten wie DEHIB Masterminds entwickeln wir innovative Ansätze, um ehrenamtliches Engagement zu professionalisieren, Kompetenzen sichtbar zu machen und Menschen neue Entwicklungsperspektiven zu eröffnen. Damit aus diesen Ideen erfolgreiche Projekte werden, brauchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und dich. Deine Aufgaben · Projekte eigenständig steuern: Projekte von der ersten Planung über die operative Umsetzung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss begleiten · DEHIB Masterminds mitgestalten: Beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unseres Qualifizierungs- und Leadership-Programms

Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either. That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description: Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Since our inception in 2014, founded by a team of scientists from CERN, we have dedicated ourselves to providing free and open-source technology to millions worldwide, ensuring access to privacy, security, and freedom online. Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations. Proton today supports over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world s top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. Proton has become profitable and reached scale without relying upon VC funding, largely due to superior talent that allows us to do things faster, more creatively, and more efficiently. We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. jobs.title: Trading Manager
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files. Where we are: Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze. Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists. The team Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further. The role A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them. You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. jobs.title: Manager I, Engineering - Husky
jobs.description: Husky is what we call the distributed, petabyte-scale columnar event store at the heart of our Event Platform, which powers dozens of Datadog’s most popular products – Logs, RUM, APM , Cloud Network Monitoring, Netflow, and many more. Husky was built from the ground up at Datadog to store and query massive volumes of event data at low cost, with data fully queryable within seconds of arrival. As an Engineering Manager on Husky, you will lead one of a few closely collaborating teams that work directly on Husky’s internals. Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life. To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: • Patients first. • Learn fast. • Own the quality. • Succeed together. • Care deeply. Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission! The role As Numan enters an exciting new chapter of AI-powered analytics, we're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to sit at the core of our data platform and drive better decisions across the entire business. This is one of the most varied analytics engineering roles in digital health. Your work will span multiple domains - from commercial performance and marketing effectiveness through to health outcomes analytics and clinical operations - giving you a genuinely broad view of the business and the full patient journey. We are embarking on a strategic investment in AI-powered analytics, with a full remit to explore and adopt the latest and greatest technologies. You'll be shaping which tools, approaches, and practices Numan adopts as a company. jobs.title: ML Runtime Engineer
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours. The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs — fast — on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. As we open the platform to a growing roster of defense and Earth-observation partners, the team's scope and the range of silicon we target are expanding fast. As our ML Runtime Engineer , you'll own model compilation and the performance tooling behind it. We're looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. You'll move between model compilation, runtime internals, quantization, and hardware-in-the-loop CI, sometimes in the same afternoon. jobs.description: Mindset Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière . Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise. Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision , une stratégie claire , et une gouvernance solide . Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte. Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents, composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable. Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence. Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow sans friction . How we work together 🤝 Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes. Aligner Design et Engineering en continu : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production. jobs.description: About Kestra Kestra is the universal orchestration platform : open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide , including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole , Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community. About the role Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise. You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem. This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one. Conduct hands-on penetration testing and threat modeling across our web application, APIs, control plane, and cloud environments. jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. jobs.title: Stage – Ingénieur(e) Production & Industrialisation
jobs.description: Isembard est une scale-up industrielle « software-first » qui reconstruit un réseau européen et souverain de fabrication de précision. Nous fabriquons des pièces usinées complexes (tournage, fraisage 5 axes) pour la défense, le spatial, les drones et l’aéronautique. Nous travaillons l’aluminium, l’acier inoxydable, le titane et d’autres alliages aéronautiques. Notre première usine française, à Wissous, monte rapidement en cadence, avec de nouvelles machines, de nouveaux clients et de nouveaux process. Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire ingénieur(e) pour rejoindre l’équipe fondatrice. Vous travaillerez directement avec notre Ingénieur Production fondateur. Vos missions Gestion de production : appuyer le suivi quotidien de la production et la planification. Vous contribuerez aussi au respect des délais de livraison des commandes clients. Standardisation des process : rédiger et déployer avec l’équipe des instructions de travail. Elles couvriront la réception des marchandises et des matières, les expéditions, le référencement fournisseurs, ainsi que la gestion des RFQ et des documents. Management de la qualité : contribuer à la construction de notre système qualité ISO 9001 et EN 9100. jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
tags: inl - institut des nanotechnologies de lyon
jobs.description: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains. A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. jobs.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Medical Information, EMEA
jobs.description: Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn. Summary of Position: The Senior Manager, Medical Information, EMEA will be responsible for developing, managing, and delivering high-quality, accurate, and compliant medical information content to support unsolicited requests from healthcare professionals. Based in Europe and operating within a global matrix, this individual will ensure timely and accurate responses are being provided to healthcare professionals in response to their inquiries. This role necessitates a comprehensive understanding of medical information with a strong emphasis on project management, medical writing, and strategic thinking. Position Responsibilities Create custom responses to address escalated requests from the European Medical Information Call Center in addition to supporting the development of responses at the global level. Ensure call center agents are equipped with up-to-date scientific content and trained to respond accurately and professionally to HCP inquiries. Monitor and analyze inquiry trends and insights to inform scientific communications

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive
jobs.description: BlueCat and LiveAction offer complementary solutions to enhance network performance and security. LiveAction’s Network Intelligence platform transforms complex data into actionable insights, providing organizations with a comprehensive view of their network, from network and application performance to security. This enables enterprise teams to rapidly resolve network issues at scale, accelerate threat response, increase employee productivity, and reduce business risk. Meanwhile, BlueCat provides a suite of solutions that help network, security, applications, and cloud and DevOps teams optimize the IP environment, driving business outcomes forward. Together, these platforms empower organizations to maintain robust, efficient, and secure network operations. This is a senior sales role responsible for accelerating revenue growth and market expansion for BlueCat’s Integrated Network Platform, focused on our Network Observability and Network Assurance. Operating initially as a hands-on senior individual contributor, the RSD will own the full sales lifecycle while working closely with senior sales engineering resources. The role will drive a channel-first, ecosystem-led strategy, leveraging service providers, traditional telcos, systems integrators (SIs), key VARs and managed service providers (MSPs) to scale adoption across the region. A key mandate of this role is to position BlueCat holistically, selling outcomes across network visibility, resilience, security, and automation rather than point solutions. Focus is on expanding reach into larger, complex organisations that may sit both within and outside traditional “large enterprise” definitions (e.g. regulated industries, critical infrastructure, public sector-adjacent organisations, and large commercial enterprises with distributed networks). jobs.description: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. jobs.title: Assistant Financial Controller
jobs.description: About Flock Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.
